originals.citation: Abrahams, F., & Mauer, K. F. (1999). Qualitative and statistical impacts of home language on responses to the items of the Sixteen Personality Factor Questionnaire (16PF) in South Africa. South African Journal of Psychology, 29(2), 76-86.

quote: Part of the qualitative phase of Abrahams and Mauer's (1999b) study was replicated at the University of Cape Town with both native English-speaking and non-native English-speaking students.
notes: Two Abrahams & Mauer 1999 entries; the replicated qualitative (synonym) phase belongs to the 'Qualitative and statistical impacts of home language' paper, not @abrahams1999b (construct comparability). The paper's 1999a/b lettering was not verified against its reference list.
